segments.label: Earlier asylum matching
segments.definition: UK, twelve months ending in September. Sum of enforced and voluntary returns across all nationalities in table Ret_D05, excluding returns in the separate port category. An asylum history was identified from flags recorded by caseworkers.

segments.label: Linked asylum and returns records
segments.definition: Same UK period and return categories. The Home Office revised the data from October 2020 to June 2022 using its later matching method.

events.text: The Home Office introduced automated matching in 2023 and revised earlier figures from October 2020. The September 2021 point is the first full year covered by the later method.
